fixes.description: Require an explicit professor title when extracting professor candidates from faculty-style links so generic links like 교원연구성과검색 are not counted as professors.
Follow Hanyang Food & Nutrition department homepage fn.hanyang.ac.kr for official professor and lab pages, replacing stale graduate lab_03 rows for that department.
Separate professor homepage URLs from department lab-introduction pages and generalize the Hanyang department-homepage enrichment into a site-template extractor instead of a department-name branch.
Extract hidden professor detail modals from Hanyang department profile cards and use modal research-interest text for professor classification without creating lab records when no lab page exists.
Prefer verified department homepage lab_all tables for Hanyang EECE over the graduate lab index, extracting table rows with professor, phone, location, and homepage URLs.
Normalize research-scope text before storage/classification by cutting professor biography, education, career, publications, awards, and society sections from detailed research text.

Make the classification pipeline taxonomy-first: treat crawled research text as evidence, store professor interests as taxonomy labels, show category labels in UI, and document threshold-based category assignment/new-category review steps.

Use verified department-local categories as taxonomy priors for Hanyang EECE so official tracks like 반도체, 신호처리, 통신, 회로, 전기에너지, 제어/로봇 assign existing KR_Labs categories above threshold before creating suggestions.
Add a reusable overall Hanyang HTML report summarizing discovery counts, taxonomy distribution, source domains, local categories, and review-priority rows after full pipeline reruns.
Prefer URL-level department/faculty/lab role hints before full-text keyword hits so department index pages with lab links are not mislabeled as lab pages.
Suppress generic cloud/distributed taxonomy evidence on humanities pages unless explicit distributed/cloud computing context is present.
